summary: A small FastAPI service with a transfer route that updates account balances held in memory.

findings.title: Balance transfers under load
findings.explanation: The route reads the sender balance, awaits the fraud check, then writes balance - amount. Concurrent transfers read the same balance, so later writes overwrite earlier ones and money disappears.

chaos.invariant: the sum of all balances stays 10000

grill.question: Under load, money disappeared from this service. Why did that happen?
expected_points: the balance is read, then written after an await, with nothing guarding it (read-modify-write race)
concurrent requests read the same stale balance and overwrite each other's writes
make the read and write atomic: a lock per account or a database transaction
grill.follow_up: What would you change so two transfers can't interleave like that?

fix_steps.title: Make the balance update atomic
fix_steps.description: No await between reading and writing a balance without a lock or transaction.
look_for: asyncio.Lock around the read and write
hints: Look at what can run between line 44 and line 52.
What happens if a second transfer reads the balance during the fraud check?
The read and the write need to happen as one step.
